title: Tall chimneys read too short
where: chimney side (real east wall, x15..16, z3..5 / z8..9 / z12), tops at y11..13
instruction: In build.mjs section 5, add a ring of iron_bars and a 1-block exposed_copper collar above each stack cap and lower the roof tooth height one course (roof option pitch: 0.75) so the stacks stand 2+ above the ridge; re-run mcd check.

title: Name sign on the gate
where: north face, over the gate, wall plane z=2, y=4, x6..10 (real = design)
instruction: signboard() currently gives 3 tiny signs reading COG WORKS; replace with B.sign('spruce',['INVENTOR\'S','WORKS'],{facing:'north',color:'black'}) on x7, x8 and x9 at y=3 z=1, or hang a signboard ... hanging blade sign from the crane boom reading 'COG & CO'.

title: Crane boom longer, with pulley
instruction: Extend the boom: dark_oak_fence at (design x10,y5,z0) over the log, add an iron_chain loop and a lantern at the boom tip; add a second crate (barrel) stacked on the first.

title: Valve wheels and pipe flanges on the west bay
where: north face, design x2..3, y3..8 (real x13..14)
instruction: Replace the stone-grey grindstones with copper_trapdoor open wheels? If not possible, swap each grindstone for a lever on copper_block and add exposed_copper flange rings every 3rd course on the riser; add a horizontal pipe branch at y=6 into the chimney breast.

title: Gear teeth round the window
where: north face, gear window centred (8,8), z=1
instruction: Add cut_copper tooth blocks on the 8 compass points one outside the ring (skip the bottom and sides where the pilasters are) and chiseled_copper hub at the centre; keep within the pediment (y<=12).

title: East wall is blank above the pipes
instruction: Add a 2-wide window (glass_pane) at z9..10 y5..7 with surround classical trim stone_bricks, and a copper pipe riser from the y=4 run up to a vent cap at y9.

title: Sawtooth ridge finials
where: roof ridge, three peak rows (real x5, x10, x15 rows), y12..13
instruction: Place lightning_rod on the ridge every 4 cells along z (z3, z7, z11) on each of the three glazed-face peaks; add a ridge of iron_bars rail on the middle shed.

title: Weather the brickwork
where: all four walls above the plinth
instruction: mcd paint with 'all faces where bricks -> weather light' only (no vary: it injects dripstone); keep mossy off the plinth, add 'all faces ground row -> plinth stone_bricks 2' if the base reads flat.

title: Back door steps and sign
instruction: Add two stone_brick_stairs steps in front of the back door and a wall sign 'DELIVERIES' (B.sign spruce, black) on the dark oak lintel at (x8,y4,z14).

title: Gate leaf iron strapping
instruction: Add iron_bars hinges as horizontal straps at y2 on the plank panels x6..7 and x9..10 (iron_trapdoor open, facing north) so the gate reads as strapped timber.
